example: The alleged suspect ran away last night and now everybody thinks he must be guilty.
example_zh: 那個可疑的嫌犯在昨晚逃跑了，現在每個人都認為他一定有罪。
chinese: 聲稱的；被斷言的；可疑的
memory_hint: alleged 由 allege 加 -d 而成，表示聲稱的、被指稱的。

example: I like roses but unfortunately I'm allergic to them.
example_zh: 我喜歡玫瑰花，但不幸的是我對玫瑰花過敏。
memory_hint: allergic to 表對…過敏，也可比喻非常厭惡。

example: I'm sneezing but I don't have a cold; it's just an allergy.
example_zh: 我在打噴嚏，但我沒有感冒，那只是過敏。
memory_hint: allergy 指過敏反應。

example: Research shows that singing can alleviate stress.
example_zh: 研究顯示唱歌能減輕壓力。
memory_hint: alleviate 表減輕痛苦、壓力或問題。

example: You won't find any alligators here; they usually live in hot and wet areas.
example_zh: 你在這兒看不到短吻鱷，牠們通常生活在濕熱地帶。
memory_hint: alligator 指短吻鱷。

example: Television news is an alloy of journalism and show business.
example_zh: 電視新聞是新聞和表演的結合體。
memory_hint: alloy 可指金屬合金，也可比喻混合物。

example: The young girl who has a pair of almond eyes is very charming.
example_zh: 那個有一雙杏眼的年輕女孩很有魅力。
memory_hint: almond 指杏仁，也可形容杏仁狀。

example: You can go shopping with us
example_zh: or alternatively
chinese: you can wait for us at home.
synonyms: 和我們去購物還是在家等我們，你可以二者擇一。
memory_hint: instead; or else
page_end: alternatively 表或者、作為另一選擇。

example: The company didn't make amends to him for his loss so he sued the company.
example_zh: 公司沒有賠償他的損失，所以他就控告公司。
memory_hint: make amends 表賠罪、賠償。

example: They were well equipped with weapons and ammunition and were ready to set off.
example_zh: 他們已經裝備好了武器和彈藥，隨時待命出發。
memory_hint: ammunition 指彈藥、軍火。

example: The public demonstrated
example_zh: demanding a blanket amnesty for the strikers.
chinese: 民眾示威遊行，要求對罷工者全部赦免。

example: I have ample reason to believe he is innocent.
example_zh: 我有充足的理由相信他是無辜的。
memory_hint: ample 表充足、寬裕的。

example: Drawing analogies is one way of giving examples.
example_zh: 畫出相似的東西是舉例的一種方式。
memory_hint: analogy 指相似性或類比。

example: If you are puzzled
example_zh: you can consult Tom. He has an analytical mind.
chinese: 如果你有疑問可以請教 Tom，他有善於分析的頭腦。
page: analytical 指善於分析或分析性的。

example: You cannot anchor all your hopes in your father's help; instead
example_zh: you should depend on yourself.
chinese: 你不能把全部的希望都繫在你父親身上，相反地，你應該靠自己。
page: anchor 可作動詞表示固定、使停泊。

example: Anecdotes about the princess are so interesting that you must ask him to tell you about them some day.
example_zh: 關於公主的軼事非常有趣，你改天一定要他說給你聽。
memory_hint: anecdote 指短小有趣的軼事。

example: The author chooses to remain anonymous because she wants to live a simple life.
example_zh: 作者選擇保持匿名，因為她想過簡單的生活。
memory_hint: anonymous 指未署名、匿名的。

example: Ask your father to adjust the antenna; the reception is not so good.
example_zh: 叫你父親調整一下天線，因為接收效果不怎麼好。
memory_hint: antenna 指天線或昆蟲觸角。

example: Most people get excited whenever they hear the playing of their national anthem.
example_zh: 大多數人一聽到國歌的演奏，都很激動。
memory_hint: anthem 常指國歌或讚美詩。

example: This factory makes antibiotics
example_zh: which are substances that kill germs.
chinese: 這個工廠生產抗生素，抗生素是一種殺菌物質。

example: The doctor told him our bodies can produce antibodies which protect us from disease.
example_zh: 醫生告訴他我們的身體可產生抗體，抗體可以保護我們免受疾病侵襲。
memory_hint: antibody 指免疫系統產生的抗體。

example: "Tall" is the antonym of "short".
example_zh: 「高」是「矮」的反義字。
memory_hint: antonym 指反義詞。

example: Racial discrimination was institutionalized after the apartheid laws were enacted in 1948 in South Africa.
example_zh: 南非於1948年頒佈種族隔離法，從此種族歧視被制度化。
memory_hint: apartheid 指歷史上的種族隔離制度。

example: Of course they had special breathing apparatus
example_zh: otherwise
chinese: they wouldn't have been able to survive in space.
synonyms: 他們當然有特殊的呼吸裝置，要不然在太空中就不能存活。
memory_hint: equipment; implement
page_end: apparatus 指設備、裝置；通常作集合或不可數概念使用。

example: Check the appendices of the dictionary. Maybe you will find what you want.
example_zh: 查看一下字典的附錄，也許會找到你想要的東西。
memory_hint: appendix 的複數可為 appendices。

example: Potential Motivational Appraisal is an assessment that defines the motivational levels of a person.
example_zh: 個人潛力激發生涯評估是一種評定一個人激發層次的方式。
memory_hint: appraisal 指評價、評估或鑑定；由 appraise 衍生而來。

example: He is no longer our manager
example_zh: so he cannot exert any appreciable influence upon us.
chinese: 他不再是我們的經理，因此不能對我們產生很大的影響力。
synonyms: 可估計的；可察覺的；相當可觀的
memory_hint: incalculable
page: appreciable 常指大到足以被察覺或重視的。

example: All the competitors waited for the result of the contest with a great deal of apprehension.
example_zh: 所有的參賽者都非常憂慮地等待比賽的結果。
memory_hint: apprehension 可指憂慮，也可指理解或逮捕。

example: I have been working as an apprentice for her for 2 years
example_zh: but she taught me nothing.
chinese: 我當她的徒弟已經兩年了，但她沒有教我任何東西。
memory_hint: expert; teacher
page: apprentice 指跟著師傅學習技藝的人。

example: It's only an approximate estimate.
example_zh: 這只是一個大概的估計。
memory_hint: approximate 作形容詞表示大概的、近似的。

example: The father suggested that his daughter should not marry that arbitrary man.
example_zh: 父親建議女兒不要和那個專斷的人結婚。
chinese: 武斷的；專斷的；隨心所欲的
memory_hint: arbitrary 常指任意的、專斷的。

example: He saw a swallow arc the sunset sky and disappear.
example_zh: 他看到一隻燕子呈弧線飛過日落的天空，然後消失不見。
memory_hint: arc 可作動詞，表示沿弧線移動。

example: This popular magazine provides the latest news in archaeology from around the world.
example_zh: 這本熱門雜誌提供來自世界各地最新的考古資訊。
memory_hint: archaeology 指研究古代人類與遺物的學科。

example: This institution supplies sample images of the dominant architectural styles found throughout the world.
example_zh: 這個機構提供世界各地主要建築風格的樣品圖像。
chinese: 建築的；建築學的；建築術的
memory_hint: architectural 來自 architect，表示建築相關的。

example: The celebrity archive which is available online dates back to 1867.
example_zh: 這份可在線上查閱的名人檔案可追溯到1867年。
memory_hint: archive 指保存的歷史資料、文件或記錄。

example: She entered the political arena after her husband abandoned her.
example_zh: 她的丈夫拋棄她之後，就走進了政治舞台。
memory_hint: arena 也常比喻競爭或活動的領域。

example: If the nation had armored themselves against a possible attack
example_zh: they would not have been defeated.
chinese: 如果該國能做好防禦，就不會遭到打敗。
page: armor 指盔甲、裝甲，也可比喻防護。

example: This company can provide armored cars and bullet proof vehicles.
example_zh: 該公司可供應裝甲車和防彈車。
memory_hint: armored 表示有裝甲或防護的。

example: You should array yourself in ceremonial robes for the official occasion.
example_zh: 你應該為那個正式場合穿上禮服。
memory_hint: array 可作動詞，表示排列或裝扮。

example: This is the artery of New York traffic.
example_zh: 這是紐約交通的主要幹線。
memory_hint: artery 可指人體動脈，也比喻交通幹道。

example: The most important thing is to articulate your words while you are giving a speech.
example_zh: 演講時，最重要的就是清楚地說出你的話。
chinese: 清楚地講話或發音；接合
memory_hint: articulate 可指清楚表達、發音。

example: Artillery played a pivotal role in almost every major engagement of the war during the 19th century.
example_zh: 炮兵在十九世紀幾乎每場大戰役中都扮演重要角色。
memory_hint: artillery 指大炮或炮兵部隊。

example: Only fools ascribe their failure to bad luck.
example_zh: 只有愚蠢的人會把失敗歸因於運氣不好。
memory_hint: ascribe A to B 表把 A 歸因於 B。

example: It was a good idea to assault the enemy in the dark on September 2nd
example_zh: when the fog was thick.
chinese: 在九月二號夜襲敵人是個好主意，因為那天有大霧。
memory_hint: defend
page: assault 可作名詞或動詞，表示攻擊、襲擊。

example: Some immigrants can rapidly assimilate into the foreign way of life while some others cannot.
example_zh: 有些移民可以很快地被異國的生活方式同化，但有些卻不能。
memory_hint: assimilate into 表融入、同化於。

example: There are many serious health hazards associated with heavy drinking.
example_zh: 許多對健康的嚴重危害都與酗酒有關。
memory_hint: associated with 表與…有關。

example: She is all too assuming in her attitude about financial help.
example_zh: 她對於金錢援助的態度實在顯得過於自信。
chinese: 傲慢的；自大的；過份自信的
memory_hint: assuming 作形容詞表示自負、傲慢。

example: They are going on the assumption that the work will be finished at the end of this year.
example_zh: 他們根據年底可以完工的這個假定而行事。
memory_hint: on the assumption that 表在…假設下。

example: You can get the latest news from this agency on how to deal with your child's asthma.
example_zh: 你可以從該機構獲得治療你孩子哮喘症的最新資訊。
memory_hint: asthma 指氣喘、哮喘。

example: His calculations were astray
example_zh: which had cost serious loss to the company.
chinese: 他不正確的計算為公司造成嚴重的損失。
synonyms: 迷路的；離開正道的；不正確的
page: go astray 表走錯路、偏離正道。

example: Astronomers whose work depends on grant money often are under pressure to write grant proposals.
example_zh: 依靠補助金的天文學家經常處於申請補助金的壓力下。
memory_hint: astronomer 指研究天文學的人。

example: This magazine offers daily astronomy news
example_zh: star charts
antonyms: 這本雜誌提供每日天文新聞、星圖、行星圖片、日蝕等更多資訊。
memory_hint: 天文學

example: Political asylum shouldn't be mistaken with modern refugee law for the latter will involve influx of population.
example_zh: 政治庇護不應與現代難民法混淆，因為後者涉及大量人口流入。
memory_hint: political asylum 指政治庇護。

example: Until now the government has refused to apologize for all the World War II atrocities they had committed.
example_zh: 政府直到現在都拒絕為二次大戰所犯的暴行道歉。
memory_hint: atrocity 指極端殘酷的行為、暴行。

example: The middle school which is attached to a college will hold a sports meeting next month.
example_zh: 附屬於大學的中學將在下個月舉行運動會。
memory_hint: attached to 表附屬於、連接於。

example: Attempted murder is only the planning of a murder
example_zh: not the actual killing
synonyms: 企圖殺人只是殺人的計畫，不是真正的殺人行為。
page_end: attempted 常用於 attempted murder 等未遂行為。

example: The main difficulty attendant on working on weekends is lack of rest.
example_zh: 在週末工作的主要困難是缺乏休息。
memory_hint: attendant on 表伴隨著…。

example: From my attic window I feasted my eyes on the beautiful scene.
example_zh: 我從閣樓窗戶盡情欣賞外面的美景。
memory_hint: attic 指屋頂下的閣樓。

example: They can help you solve your IRS problems with their professional attorneys.
example_zh: 他們可以用專業律師幫你解決國稅局方面的問題。
memory_hint: attorney 指律師或法定代理人。

example: They auctioned their father's collections after he passed away.
example_zh: 在父親死後，他們拍賣了他的收藏品。
memory_hint: auction 可作動詞，表示以拍賣方式出售。

example: Most companies audit the books at the end of the year.
example_zh: 大部分的公司是在年底查帳。
memory_hint: audit 常指審計、查帳。

example: The auditorium was packed that day when the famous scientist came.
example_zh: 著名科學家來的那天，禮堂裡擠滿了人。
memory_hint: auditorium 指禮堂、會堂。

example: In order to get the superstar's authentic signature
example_zh: she had been following him for several months.
chinese: 為了得到那個明星的真實簽名，她已經跟蹤他好幾個月了。
memory_hint: false
page: authentic 指真實可靠、非仿冒的。

example: An authoritative teacher places controls on the students but simultaneously encourages independence.
example_zh: 一個權威的老師在管理學生的同時也會鼓勵他們獨立。
chinese: 權威性的；官方的；專斷的
memory_hint: authoritative 可指權威的、官方的。

example: Hundreds of readers asked the author to autograph their books.
example_zh: 數百名讀者要求作者在他們的書上親筆簽名。
memory_hint: autograph 作動詞表示親筆簽名。

example: At present autonomous learning is becoming more and more important
example_zh: especially for college students.
chinese: 現在自主學習變得越來越重要，特別是對大學生而言。

example: All their efforts to save the general came to no avail.
example_zh: 他們為了拯救將軍而做的努力都無用。
memory_hint: to no avail 表徒勞、沒有用。

example: If you are really innocent
example_zh: there is no need to avert suspicion.
chinese: 如果你真的是清白的，就沒有必要躲避嫌疑。
page: avert 可指避免、防止，也可指轉開。

example: Cages
example_zh: aviaries which simulate a natural environment allow birds a larger living space.
chinese: 鳥籠和模擬自然環境的鳥舍，讓鳥有較大的生活空間。

example: There was a boom in commercial and defense aviation industries after WWII.
example_zh: 二次大戰後，商業和軍事航空業曾經繁榮。
memory_hint: aviation 泛指航空、航空業。

example: The Ford candidate has a large backing so he stands a good chance of winning the election.
example_zh: 福特候選人有大批支持者，所以他很有勝選機會。
memory_hint: backing 指支持、援助。

example: School badges are usually symbols representing a school's traditional spirit and their visions.
example_zh: 學校徽章通常象徵學校的傳統精神和願景。
memory_hint: badge 指徽章、標誌。

example: The police are baffled as to how the thieves broke into the bank.
example_zh: 警方對小偷如何闖入銀行感到困惑。
memory_hint: baffle 表使困惑、阻撓。

example: The company declared bankruptcy until a bank bailed them out.
example_zh: 這家公司宣告破產，直到有一家銀行出手援助。
memory_hint: bail out 表救助、使脫困。

example: The ballast placed in the ship can keep the ship steady.
example_zh: 放在船上的壓艙物可以保持船身平穩。
memory_hint: ballast 指使船保持穩定的壓艙物。

example: A majority balloted for the bill.
example_zh: 大多數人投票贊成該法案。
memory_hint: ballot 可指選票，也可指投票表決。

example: Representation of life in his works is stupid
example_zh: banal and childish.
chinese: 他作品中對生活的描繪是愚蠢、陳腐和幼稚的。
page: banal 指陳腐、平庸而缺乏新意。

example: The company was on the brink of bankruptcy.
example_zh: 該公司已瀕臨破產。
memory_hint: on the brink of bankruptcy 表瀕臨破產。

example: The visitors were very appreciative that a banquet was given in honor of them.
example_zh: 參訪者非常感激為他們舉辦的宴會。
memory_hint: banquet 指正式宴會。

example: Don't take people living in deep forests as barbarians.
example_zh: 不要把住在深山裡的人當成野蠻人。
memory_hint: barbarian 指野蠻人或未開化者。

example: They are unloading the oil barge
example_zh: which has been just back from England.
chinese: 他們正在卸下一艘剛從英國回來的油駁船。

example: Some of the indicators are often barometers of university trends.
example_zh: 有些指標往往是大學發展趨勢的晴雨表。
memory_hint: barometer 除氣壓計外，也可比喻衡量趨勢的指標。

example: There is a deserted army barracks at the foot of the mountain.
example_zh: 山腳下有一座被遺棄的兵營。
memory_hint: barracks 常指軍營、兵營。

example: It is a real wonder that one can tramp through this barren desert.
example_zh: 一個人能徒步穿越這片荒漠真是奇蹟。
memory_hint: barren 指貧瘠、荒蕪的。

example: They barricaded the main road so the enemy had to go the other way which was their ambush.
example_zh: 他們在主要道路設置路障，因此敵人只好改走另一條埋伏路線。
memory_hint: barricade 可作名詞或動詞，表示路障或設障阻擋。
